films.title: Cozy Halloween Cabin Ambience 4K | 8 Hours of Storm, Fire & Ghosts for Sleep (No Music, No Loops)
films.description:
A cozy cabin on a stormy Halloween night, 8 hours long. No music. No loops.

Rain patters on the roof and runs down the windows, thunder rolls softly over the mountains, and the fire crackles by the hearth. A black cat sleeps on the sheepskin, a skeleton sits in the armchair beside her, and jack-o'-lanterns glow among the candles under a violet storm sky.

Every so often a ghost slips out of the wall and floats through the cabin, or drifts over the valley outside, and the jack-o'-lanterns flicker out and light again. Otherwise it is quiet: no bells, no sudden sounds, just weather and firelight. Made for sleep.

This is a real-time 3D world built from scratch, recorded one frame at a time in 4K. The picture and the sound are generated live, so nothing repeats: you'll never see or hear the same moment twice.

Leave it running for sleep, study, reading or a cozy October night.

films.title: Haunted Coral Reef 4K 60fps | 3 Hours Spooky Underwater Halloween Ambience (No Music)
films.description:
Three hours of a haunted coral reef in 4K 60fps: dark, moonlit Halloween ambience with no music, for sleep, study, reading or a spooky night in.

A pirate's wreck lies broken on the sand, one lantern still burning in its rigging. Nearby a skeleton keeps watch over his treasure chest, while a ghost ship drifts silently across the surface overhead. Among the living fish swim the bones of those that never left. An anglerfish hunts with its glowing lure, pale ghost jellies pulse through the dark, the corals glow under the moon, and eyes watch from the cracks in the rocks.

This reef is a real-time 3D world by Greenfield Studio. The fish models were made with the help of generative AI. Nothing in this video loops: every fish swims by its own behaviour, and the eerie soundscape (deep drones, a moaning current, the creak of old timber and distant whale song) is generated live, so it never repeats.

Perfect as:
- Halloween background for a party, movie night or trick-or-treat evening
- a spooky aquarium on your TV or second screen
- dark ambience for sleep, study, reading or deep work

More reef ambience on this channel. Made by Greenfield Studio: https://www.youtube.com/@Greenfield.Studio

A cozy cabin on a stormy Halloween night. No music. No loops.

Rain patters on the roof and runs down the windows, thunder rolls over the mountains, and the fire crackles and sends up sparks. A black cat sleeps on the sheepskin by the hearth, until the thunder wakes her, or something drifts past. In the armchair beside her, a skeleton sips from a brass goblet and keeps an eye on the room. Jack-o'-lanterns glow among the candles, the old clock ticks and chimes the hour, and beyond the glass a violet storm sky hangs over an eerie green mist.

Every so often a ghost slips out of the wall and floats through the cabin, or drifts over the valley outside. Watch closely: the jack-o'-lanterns go out one by one and light again, a handprint appears on the misted window, a chess piece moves by itself and the other side answers, and once, a candle floats.

This is a real-time 3D world built from scratch, recorded one frame at a time in 4K 60fps. The picture and the sound are generated live, so nothing repeats: you'll never see or hear the same moment twice.

Leave it running for sleep, study, reading or a cozy October night.
